paite: Huan Philistia mite'n Israelte asual ua; Philistia mite a pan Israelte ataikek ua, Gilboa tang ah thah in a-om zelzul uhi.
heading: Saul Leh Atapate Sihna / (1 Kro 10.1-12)

paite: Philistia mite'n Saul leh atapa adelhzui vengveng uh. Philistia mite'n Saul tapate: Jonathan, Abinadab leh Melkishua athat uhi.
Saul anak sual mahmah ua, thalkap mite'n akapkhata ua, thalkap mite'n nasatak in akapliam uhi.

Huchi in Saul in agalvan tawipa kiang ah, "Na namsau dok inla, hon sun pailet in. Huchi lou in zaw hiai zeksumlouhte ahong pai ding ua, hong sun pailet ding ua, hon bawlse kha ding uh," achi hi. Himahleh agalvan tawipa'n ahih ut kei; alau mahmah ngal a. Huaiziak in Saul in anamsau ala a, abohkhumta hi.
Agalvan tawipa'n Saul asi chih atheih in ama'n leng anamsau abohkhum samta a, asikhawmta uh.
Huchi in Saul, atapa thumte, agalvan tawipa leh ami tengteng huai ni mah in asikhawm vek uhi.

Guam gal khat lam a Israel mi omte leh Jordan gal a omte'n Israel mite ataikek uh, chih leh Saul leh atapate asi uh chih atheih un khuate apawtkhiaksan ua, ataimangta uhi. Huchi in Philistia mite'n ava luahta uhi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, azingsang in Philistiate agalthahte uh puansilh suahsak ding a ava pai uleh Saul leh atapate thum Gilboa tang a si ava mu uhi.
Alu atan ua, agalvan asuahkhiaksak ua, mite kiang leh amilimte inn a suah ding in akim ua Philistia mite gam teng ah akhak uhi.
Ashtaroth inn ah agalvan akoih ua; Beth-shan kulhbaang ah aluang atak uhi.
Jabesh-Gilead a omte'n Philistia mite'n Saul abawldan thu ana zak un,
mihangsan tengteng athou ua, zankhua in apai ua, Saul luang leh atapate luang Beth-shan kulhbaang a pan alakhia uh. Jabesh atung ua, huai ah ahal uhi.
Aguhte ala ua, Jabesh a sing nuai ah avui ua, ni sagih sung an angawl uhi.
